cases.question: What is radiomics and how are quantitative features extracted from pancreatic CT images?
aspects: ROI segmentation followed by feature extraction/model building
cases.scope: General workflow relevant; CT-specific claims require CT evidence.

cases.question: How has artificial intelligence been studied with endoscopic ultrasound for pancreatic cystic lesions?
aspects: EUS or EUS-nCLE AI study for pancreatic cysts/IPMNs
cases.scope: Exclude MRI/CT-only cyst studies and solid-tumor EUS studies.

cases.question: How have CT radiomic models been studied for pancreatic cancer detection?
aspects: Radiomic detection study distinguishing cancer from normal pancreas
cases.scope: CT radiomics detection; exclude PET/CT, MRI, neuroendocrine grading, prognosis, and deep-learning-only evidence.

cases.question: What cohort and accuracy were reported for CNN analysis of EUS-nCLE video frames to identify advanced neoplasia in IPMNs?
cases.scope: Only EUS-nCLE CNN study; other EUS modalities are not substitutes.

cases.question: What local and external test performance was reported for the contrast-enhanced CT radiomics model detecting pancreatic cancer in more than 1000 subjects?
aspects: Contrast-enhanced CT radiomics detection in more than 1000 subjects
cases.scope: Do not substitute CNN results or prognosis/grade prediction.

cases.question: How did MRI radiomics compare with a clinical model for differentiating pancreatic cancer from mass-forming chronic pancreatitis in the study by Deng?
aspects: MRI differential diagnosis and comparison with clinical model
cases.scope: Exclude EUS and PET/CT sentences even when in the same passage.

cases.question: Which PET/CT tracer and tumor grades were used in the pancreatic neuroendocrine radiomics detection study by Bevilacqua?
cases.scope: PET/CT neuroendocrine evidence explicitly relevant here; exclude adjacent MRI study.

cases.question: What randomized trial evidence shows that CT radiomics screening reduces pancreatic cancer mortality?
cases.scope: Prediction/retrospective studies are not randomized mortality-reduction evidence; abstain.

cases.question: What prospective multicenter clinical validation results are reported for the PROWL system?
cases.scope: PROWL absent from retained reviews; other systems are not evidence for PROWL; abstain.

cases.question: Which pancreatic CT radiomics model is proven to detect every cancer with zero false positives in all future patients?
cases.scope: Finite study estimates cannot prove universal future performance; abstain even for reported AUC 1.00.

notes: Corpus-informed, author-reviewed references; not exhaustive relevance labels or held-out evaluation. Three previously exercised regressions and seven new questions. Reference IDs, aspects, expected statuses and scope rubrics are never model inputs. Missing-evidence expectations concern this frozen corpus only.
